create.info: To keep the creation of new groups under some control (e.g. to avoid identical or similar groups for the same purpose), the role 'privileged' is required. That role is essentially held by the board members. If you would like to open your own group, please say so in the support chat, with the name of the group, its members and its purpose. You then become the administrator of that group and can, for example, manage the group members, create new events and so on.

article.title: Article
article.content:
This is your group home page.

Only group members see this content.

The group administrator can change the content of this page as desired. To do so, use the operations in the context menu at the top right.

Currently you will find here a guide to the group functions.

Depending on the configuration, a group can contain the following functions:

  • Home page (this one): information that remains the same over a longer period and is relevant to the group members.

  • Calendar

  • Todos

  • Members: a list of the group members; the group administrator can add new members or delete existing ones.

  • Files: a file storage for sharing files within the group

The group administrator can turn these functions on and off.

okey.label: okey
okey.helper: The key of the group in the database, a unique ID, usually assigned automatically.

id.label: Group ID
id.helper: A unique identifier for the group.

name.label: Name of the group
name.helper: A readable name for the group, so that it can be found more easily in lists.

icon.label: Icon
icon.helper: The name of a graphical symbol.

visibility.label: Visibility (roles)
visibility.helper: Comma-separated role names (e.g. registered,privileged). Users with one of these roles see the group's calendar and chat, even without being a member. Empty = members only.

notifyType.label: Notification type
notifyType.helper: memberOnly: only members receive notifications. membersAndMatchingVisibility: members and users with a matching visibility role.

hasContent.label: Show content
hasContent.helper: The GroupAdmin can create and manage their own content.

hasChat.label: Show chat
hasChat.helper: The group members can chat with each other.

hasCalendar.label: Show calendar
hasCalendar.helper: The group members can manage appointments in their own calendar.

hasTasks.label: Show tasks
hasTasks.helper: The group's tasks can be handled in a dedicated todo list.

hasFiles.label: Show files
hasFiles.helper: The group has its own storage area where its members can store their files.

hasAlbum.label: Show albums
hasAlbum.helper: Photos can be displayed in an album of the group.

hasMembers.label: Show members
hasMembers.helper: The members of the group are shown to all group members.

info.title: About groups
info.intro: A group bundles everything a handful of people share: the conversation, the shared dates and the related documents. New groups start lean with chat, calendar and members — the group administrator enables the remaining areas in the group configuration when they are needed. As a rule, a group is visible only to its members.

members.title: Members
members.text: The list of all people who belong to the group. Only they see the group content and receive notifications from the group chat.

chat.title: Chat
chat.text: The closed group chat for everything short-lived: arrangements, questions, spontaneous changes. Every new message is pushed to the members.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.text: The group’s events — training sessions, meetings, occasions. They additionally appear in the members’ personal calendar and can be exported to their own calendar.

content.title: Content
content.text: The group’s home page for information that stays valid for a longer time: concepts, instructions, contacts. It is maintained by the group administrators.

tasks.title: Todos
tasks.text: The group’s open items with an owner and a due date. Without an assigned person a todo goes to the group’s main contact.

files.title: Files
files.text: The group’s shared folder for documents, photos and PDFs — available to all members, on any device.

admin.title: Group administration
admin.text: Every group has one or more administrators. They manage the members, create events, maintain the content and decide which areas the group offers at all. The administrator listed first is also the main contact.

chatMode.label: Chat mode for non-members
chatMode.helper: shared: non-members join the common group room and read everything. ask: every non-member gets their own room with the whole group — for groups that should be reachable by everyone but whose requests are confidential (emergency, support, board, committees).
